content: Radyiyada ji̱ta jarichumu riva ratarya dityanuta̱ntiy jiryatiy jaryi ti̱ttasara darya. Rivyicha̱da danu̱ju̱ñijyate Ju̱denu jpa̱vay, jiryatiy daraju̱ñijyate diitya̱tavaryi. Jirya diitya̱ta sa̱dityanumu̱y Ju̱denura jiñique̱yada (juuchuveda jiyaro̱ju̱).

Radyiyada ji̱ta riva mityo̱ nu̱tyu nuvatusumatiy daryá, nu̱tyu jiiday raryiye̱ya̱ nta. Radyiyada ruuva suvu̱chi̱ vuunuvay, jiryatiy rivyuudodani̱, sa̱ntyasi̱ jarye, si̱tya nu̱chara jarye risa̱ju̱. Riryadeda ji̱ta mityo̱ncha, jiryatiy nu̱tyu nuvatusuma dárya, rivyicha̱da Ju̱denu quitáratavay ti̱ta̱ju̱.
Rimyurra̱yada ji̱tara Muyisésibe murra̱yada, jiryatiy Ju̱denu muchechidyeñi̱, Carni̱ru murra̱yada jarye risa̱ju̱:

content.text: “Jaryi ti̱ttasara ji̱ta yivaayada, ti̱ta̱ju̱ jvaarya ji, Nutyityu̱ Ju̱denu. Vasera, si̱tenu jarye risa̱ju̱ darya jiñú̱ day, nijya̱nvajyuu nutyityu̱ daryaju̱ ji. ¿Chi̱ramu̱y ne ra̱suvu̱charara yitya, Nutyityu̱, chi̱? ra̱vandanu varintyirya. Vinu jiiñi rañi̱cha jiintyasi̱. Rirya̱jti̱ ti̱ta̱ju̱ nijya̱nvajyuu yimuju̱ rirya̱tidye jadasiñu jityuunuyu jiryatiy jvadichara yivaayada vase darya.”

content: Rivasiy ji̱ta ri̱nu̱yada, ramutteda jarichuvimu Ju̱denunijyu̱ jachipiya̱jotera, jiryatiy ru̱tachara jaryi samiryava̱ju̱ Ju̱denu jtedamuju̱ra.

Richipyateda ji̱ta danu̱ju̱ñijyate Ju̱denu jpa̱vay ravimusiy, daraju̱ñijyate diitya̱ tavay. Rivyicha̱da ja̱muca̱ sujatyavay jaryi pupajay, vandajay jarye risa̱ju̱ra, jiryatiy puchusara ritya̱savu̱mu puchunajetyara, jiryatiy órutera darya.
Ti̱qui jnu̱vyetyenu sa̱yada variy rirya dasiijyu̱ñijyate ju̱no̱siy, jiryatiy mu̱chanichara Ju̱denu nique̱yadatara, ni̱tiy vichajaya̱sara ju̱na̱reju̱.

Ramu̱cha̱da ji̱ta Ju̱denunijyu̱ jachipiya̱jo nuvachitya jiryatiy sadámusirya, savanu̱yadamusiy jarye risa̱ju̱ra. Ne vana̱y ti̱ jayada variy Ju̱denunijyu̱ jachipiya̱jovimu, netimyu̱ ne rito̱tanimyu̱ daraju̱ñijyate diitya̱ didye, jiryatiy danu̱ju̱ñijyate jpa̱savamyura.
